description: This file defines Express.js routes for authentication functionalities, including health check, user signup, login with password verification and migration, and password reset. It interacts with user and tenant data models, uses utility functions for hashing and validation, and exposes API endpoints primarily under /api/auth.

methods.name: router.get('/health')
methods.description: Health check endpoint to verify tenant salt configuration status, returning flags and warnings without exposing secrets.

methods.name: router.post('/signup')
methods.description: Endpoint to create or update a user with a tenant-specific hashed password, ensuring tenant validation and automatic orgSalt generation if needed.

methods.name: router.post('/login')
methods.description: Authenticate a user with credentials, supporting migration from legacy hashes to tenant-specific scheme upon successful login.

methods.name: router.post('/reset-password')
methods.description: Password reset endpoint that rehashes the new password with tenant-specific hashing. Used for demonstration without production-level token verification.
